annotations.title: Render a website's pages in a real browser

description: Renders a website in a real headless browser (JavaScript run) and returns the visible text of its start page plus linked contact, about and team pages. Use it to read a company or product site whose content needs JavaScript, or to collect its contact and about pages in one call. Use job_doc_to_markdown instead when you already hold the HTML or document file. Cost: $0.013 per page rendered, debited from your balance; only usable rows are charged, an empty or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

max_results.description: Most page rendereds to return and pay for (default 3, at most 20); the run stops there.

url.description: The site's https start URL, e.g. its home page.

name: job_site_render

items.description: {url, final_url, http_status, title, text, emails, phones}

usable.description: rows that carry data (only these are charged)
